fusions.name: Windrow Sweep
fusions.desc: Rakes a ring around you that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Fine-Tooth Pass
fusions.desc: Drags a blow across the target for 8 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Tidy Silt
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 15% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Gleaned Strength
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
